reviews.snippet: I visited with my husband and our toddler. We ordered eggs parathas and egg bhurji. Food was tasty, fresh and less oily as I requested. This place is having very old ambience (almost outdated). I did not like big garbage box in the main dining hall where waiters was throwing away things by lifting garbage box lid by bare hands and after was continuing to work without washing hands. In the ground floor dining hall is too dark as for restaurant. Bathroom is not is good condition and I hesitated that I should use it or wait until I reach home. There's no baby chair.
